# Mutation fuzzing of the format parsers (generated by evaluation/fuzz_formats.py)

Seed 20261024, 6300 damaged files built from the benign clean-twin fixtures. Limits: 20.0 s and 256.0 MB per file. Slowest file 10.053 s, highest peak 8.7 MB.

Made on: Windows, Python 3.14.3, h5py 3.16.0, onnx 1.23.2, numpy 2.4.4, joblib 1.5.3, zlib 1.3.1.zlib-ng. Each format has its own random stream, so on another system
only the rows whose seed differs (SHA-256 in the last table) can change; timings and peaks always differ.

| format | cases | reported not clean | reported clean | known limit | **failures** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| catboost | 300 | 95 | 205 | 0 | **0** |
| cfg | 300 | 17 | 283 | 0 | **0** |
| gguf | 300 | 245 | 55 | 0 | **0** |
| ipynb | 300 | 247 | 53 | 0 | **0** |
| joblib | 300 | 272 | 28 | 0 | **0** |
| joblib-zlib | 300 | 300 | 0 | 0 | **0** |
| json | 300 | 29 | 271 | 0 | **0** |
| keras-h5 | 300 | 216 | 84 | 0 | **0** |
| keras-v3 | 300 | 235 | 65 | 0 | **0** |
| npy-object | 300 | 261 | 39 | 0 | **0** |
| npy-strings | 300 | 103 | 197 | 0 | **0** |
| npz | 300 | 209 | 91 | 0 | **0** |
| onnx | 300 | 196 | 104 | 1 | **0** |
| pickle | 300 | 271 | 29 | 0 | **0** |
| pickle-proto2 | 300 | 267 | 33 | 0 | **0** |
| safetensors | 300 | 282 | 18 | 0 | **0** |
| torch-legacy | 300 | 270 | 30 | 0 | **0** |
| torch-zip | 300 | 263 | 37 | 0 | **0** |
| txt | 300 | 19 | 281 | 0 | **0** |
| yaml | 300 | 21 | 279 | 0 | **0** |
| zip-nested | 300 | 276 | 24 | 0 | **0** |

"Reported clean" is not an error by itself: most damage to text, and some damage to binary files, leaves
a file that is still valid. Only a truncated binary file must never come back clean (rule `clean-cut`).
"Known limit" is a cut inside bytes the scanner never parses by design (CatBoost extra data after the model
core; the raw tensor bytes of a legacy PyTorch file), or a cut exactly between two top-level fields of an ONNX
file, which leaves a complete, valid file. Those cuts are not detected, and the README says so.

**No failures.**

| file | cut at byte | why |
|---|---|---|
| onnx_0204.onnx | 140 | known-limit: cut between two top-level protobuf fields (the rest is a complete, valid file) |
